summary_ko: 기존 해석적 rank 인증과 외부 정리를 연결하는 후속 구현을 위한 조사 기록이다. 이 파일은 새 산술 계산, descent/Selmer certificate, Lean proof 또는 leading BSD 검증 결과가 아니다.

primary_sources.author: V. A. Kolyvagin
primary_sources.title: On the Mordell-Weil group and the Shafarevich-Tate group of modular elliptic curves
primary_sources.verified_statement: For a modular elliptic curve E over Q, analytic rank at most one implies equality of algebraic and analytic ranks and finiteness of Sha(E/Q).
proof_dependencies: Gross-Zagier relation between Heegner-point height and L-series derivative
Auxiliary quadratic-twist nonvanishing results attributed in Theorem 4 to Waldspurger and to Bump-Friedberg-Hoffstein / Murty-Murty
primary_sources.additional_reference_only_fact: Example 2 treats Y^2 = 4X^3 - 4X + 1, identifies the rational generator (X,Y)=(0,1), and states Sha=0. Its relation to 37a1 via X=x, Y=2y+1 requires an exact model-binding adapter before machine use. No such adapter was implemented or executed in this research.

primary_sources.author: Andrew Wiles
primary_sources.title: Modular elliptic curves and Fermat's Last Theorem
primary_sources.verified_statement: Every semistable elliptic curve over Q is modular.

primary_sources.title: Heegner points and derivatives of L-series
primary_sources.role: Primary background for the height/derivative dependency; the exact rank-equality adapter statement should use Kolyvagin Theorem 1, not infer an upper rank bound from Gross-Zagier alone.

primary_sources.title: Computing Canonical Heights on Elliptic Curves in Quasi-Linear Time
primary_sources.role: Canonical-height local decomposition, exact non-archimedean corrections, and explicit normalization warning.

primary_sources.title: The complex AGM, periods of elliptic curves over C and complex elliptic logarithms
primary_sources.role: Computable period formulas with branch and lattice-normalization conditions; no ball implementation was added.

conclusion_if_all_inputs_and_dependencie.sha_finiteness: External theorem conclusion; does not by itself compute Sha order.

exact_hypotheses: E is a nonsingular elliptic curve over Q with exact model identity bound to the analytic certificate.
E is modular; for these semistable fixtures this may be obtained through Wiles Theorem 0.4 after binding the complete reduction/conductor evidence.
L(E,s) is the full Hasse-Weil L-function with all bad-prime factors, not a good-only partial Euler product.
The analytic certificate proves ord_{s=1} L(E,s) is exactly 0 or 1: nonzero central value, or exact parity vanishing plus a derivative ball excluding zero, respectively.
The external theorem statement and dependency identity are recorded explicitly; a literature link is not a Lean theorem import.
not_required_by_this_rank_corollary: A chosen prime with a surjective residual Galois representation
proposed_rank_bridge.direct_heegner_reconstruction_not_perfor: Invoking Kolyvagin Theorem 1 uses its established composite result. Reconstructing the proof directly would additionally require binding a suitable imaginary quadratic field, Heegner hypotheses, and auxiliary nonvanishing results. No Heegner point or auxiliary twist was computed here.
no_inference_to: Saturation of a displayed rational point

period.invariant_differential: omega = dx/(2*y + a1*x + a3) on the certified global minimal model
period.bsd_real_period: Omega = integral over E(R) of |omega| = least positive real period times the number of real connected components
period.next_computation: Certified cubic-root isolation, justified square-root/AGM branches, explicit convergence enclosure, and exact model differential scaling.
period.warning: Using only the least positive real period for 37a1 omits a factor of two.

height.chosen_proposed_convention: H(P) = lim_{n->infinity} 4^(-n) h_x(2^n P), where h_x(a/b)=log(max(|a|,|b|)) for coprime integers a,b and b>0.
height.normalization_warning: This H is twice the canonical height convention used in Silverman's books, as explicitly stated in Mueller-Stoll Remark 3.1. Pairing and regulator formulas must use the same convention.
height.decomposition: H(P)=h_x(P)-sum_v Psi_v(P), with finite-place exact rational-log corrections and an archimedean contribution with a proved error enclosure.
height.next_computation: Keep finite-place corrections, archimedean approximation, rounding and omitted-series error distinct.

regulator.rank_one: For a certified full Mordell-Weil basis G, Reg=H(G). If P=m*G modulo torsion, H(P)=m^2*Reg.
regulator.saturation_warning: A positive height certifies non-torsion but does not certify that the point is a full generator.

leading_term.warning: This research records a target formula, not a newly certified equality. A numerical ratio near an integer does not prove the order of Sha or the refined BSD formula.
leading_term.sha_status_rule: Finiteness from the general rank theorem and an exact Sha-order theorem or computation are separate fields.
